item.title: Jin Saotome and Blade of Scion added to Ultimate Marvel vs. Capcom 3: Community Edition with cool trailers showing off what they can do
item.description: <p>Although the fighting game modding community already goes hard in general, the modders of Marvel vs. Capcom are next level in terms of their dedication.</p> <p>The <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/apr/04/marvel-capcom-community-edition/">Ultimate Marvel vs. Capcom 3: Community Edition mod project</a> has now received a new update adding an MvC classic and newcomer to the ever-expanding roster.</p>

item.title: Toph gameplay trailer for Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game coming February 12
item.description: <p>It's been around four months since <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/oct/12/avatar-legends-fighting-game-trailer/">Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game was announced</a> as a revival of the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2024/dec/03/avatar-fighting-game-canceled/">previously canceled project</a>, and we're finally about to see another fighter in action.</p> <p>One of the all-time fan-favorite Avatar characters is receiving her gameplay trailer in a matter of hours.</p>

item.title: Pop star The Weeknd visits Street Fighter 6 developers and is apparently a big fan of one character in particular
item.description: <p>The cultural impact of Street Fighter on multiple generations is often underappreciated, so there's more people from all walks of life who are (or were at one time) fans of the video game icon.</p> <p>That seems to even extend to the likes of The Weeknd, given the pop star's recent trip to Japan.</p>

item.title: New Dead or Alive project and Dead or Alive 6: Last Round announced
item.description: <p>Dead or Alive has been quiet for quite a few years now, but that's no longer the case.</p> <p>Koei Tecmo made a surprise appearance during today's <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/feb/12/state-play-marvel-tokon/">State of Play event</a> where they announced Dead or Alive 6: Last Round as well as a brand new Dead or Alive project.</p>

item.title: Toph gameplay trailer for Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game released
item.description: <p>Despite <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2024/dec/03/avatar-fighting-game-canceled/">being canceled</a>, the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/oct/12/avatar-legends-fighting-game-trailer/">Avatar fighting game was surprisingly revived</a> last year, and now we get to see more of the project in action.</p> <p>Gameplay Group International just dropped the gameplay trailer for Toph in Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game.</p>
